name: docdrift
description: AI Code Intelligence & Documentation Platform — detects documentation drift in GitHub pull requests.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @docdrift/shared" "npm run dev -w @docdrift/api" "npm run dev -w @docdrift/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && npm run test:integration -w @docdrift/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --ui
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && npm run eval -w @docdrift/api --
scripts.eval:import: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && npm run eval:import -w @docdrift/api --
scripts.eval:anchors: npm run build -w @docdrift/shared && npm run eval:anchors -w @docdrift/api --
